countingRules.topLevelDirs: find . -maxdepth 1 -type d, excluding '.' and '.git'. INCLUDES dotfolders (.claude, .cursor, .vercel).
countingRules.fileCount: find <path> -type f — every file, all extensions, all depths, EXCLUDING ./.git/. Not limited to .md, not limited to tracked.
countingRules.criticalCaveat: A file inside a NESTED GIT REPO is invisible to all three git commands from the parent. It is neither tracked, untracked, nor ignored — it belongs to another repository. 375 files in this repo are in that state and any git-based count silently omits them.

structuralViolationsFound.finding: A FULL NESTED GIT CLONE of the product repo lives inside doc_repo. 186 files, of which 185 are invisible to the parent git entirely (0 tracked, 0 untracked, 1 ignored) because they belong to another repository.
structuralViolationsFound.evidence: remote origin https://github.com/empressaioemail-tech/hauska-mcp-server.git; branch main; HEAD 080eb01 2026-07-02 'feat(cortex): add compose_workspace MCP tool (Track E adaptive interface) (#34)'
structuralViolationsFound.twist: This is ALREADY A RECORDED RULING that was never executed. .gitignore:12-13 carries the instruction verbatim: 'Stray full clone of the product repo left inside doc_repo; product code, not strategy. Do not commit; delete the clone.' So the correct disposition is written down and the clone is still here.
structuralViolationsFound.staleness: HEAD is 2026-07-02, six weeks behind. Any agent reading it as source would read stale product code.
structuralViolationsFound.disposition: REPORT ONLY per dispatch. Operator ruling.

structuralViolationsFound.finding: A SECOND full nested git clone, 189 files. Same invisibility. NOT gitignored, NOT tracked — completely unrecorded, unlike SV-1.
structuralViolationsFound.evidence: remote origin https://github.com/empressaioemail-tech/hauska-brief-extension.git; branch main; HEAD fc46920 2026-07-16 'feat(web): spine proxy for shared component library tiles (Brief Layer 2) (#8)'
structuralViolationsFound.criticalDetail: The directory NAME says 'brief-l3-spine-consume' and the remote is hauska-brief-extension — a DIFFERENT repo from SV-1. A temp working clone from an L3 spine-consume task, never removed.
structuralViolationsFound.whyWorseThanSV1: SV-1 is at least documented in .gitignore. SV-2 has no record anywhere: no ignore rule, no tracking, no note. It is a silent 189-file foreign repo.
structuralViolationsFound.disposition: REPORT ONLY per dispatch. Operator ruling.

structuralViolationsFound.finding: Only TWO nested repos exist (verified by find -name .git to depth 3), so the class is bounded at 375 files. But every git-based file count in this repo silently omits them, which is why FS and git counts disagree by more than the untracked figure explains.
structuralViolationsFound.reconciliation: filesystem 4,970 = tracked 2,416 + untracked 2,124 + ignored 57 + nested-repo-invisible 373. (4,970 - 2,416 - 2,124 - 57 = 373; the 2-file remainder against the 375 gross is the 2 nested-repo files git DOES see: 1 ignored in hauska-mcp-server, 1 untracked in tmpbrief.) Two numbers that should agree and did not, reconciled rather than rounded off.

wholesaleUntrackedDirs.finding: Six directories are entirely or nearly untracked while NOT being ignored — meaning they exist on this machine only and would vanish on a fresh clone. This is the same class as the G0 .cursor finding, at directory scale.
wholesaleUntrackedDirs.rule: fs file count > 0 AND tracked = 0 AND ignored = 0
wholesaleUntrackedDirs.sharpestCase: _smartsite_masters/ is UNTRACKED while _smartcity_masters/ (39 tracked) is the ratified REFERENCE SET. A masters folder that does not survive a clone is a reference set nobody else can read.
wholesaleUntrackedDirs.alsoNotable: _sales/03_smartcity_os.md is named in the _smartcity_masters README reconciliation-debt list and G0 proposed a disposition for it — but the whole _sales/ directory is untracked, so that doc is not in the repo for anyone else.
wholesaleUntrackedDirs.disposition: REPORT. Operator ruling on track-or-ignore per directory.

harnessBugCaughtAndFixed.bug: The planner's first per-directory loop word-split on spaces, so 'Master Collateral Folder' appeared as three phantom rows named Master / Collateral / Folder, each with 0 files.
harnessBugCaughtAndFixed.impact: Would have produced 3 fabricated directory rows and omitted a real 11-file directory.
harnessBugCaughtAndFixed.fix: re-counted that path with explicit quoting; confirmed 11 files, 0 tracked, 11 untracked.
harnessBugCaughtAndFixed.note: Recorded because the map's whole value is that its rows are real. A phantom row is worse than a missing one.
